company.name: Retape
company.shortDescription: Retape develops AI-native CRM and workflow automation software for debt settlement and financial services operations.
company.description: Retape develops AI-native software that automates operational workflows for financial services organizations, with a focus on debt settlement and collection operations. The company offers a CRM platform under the Resolve brand that functions as a shared context layer for multi-agent AI systems. Its autonomous AI workers specialize in tasks such as sales outreach, client servicing, negotiation, intake processing, and account structuring. The platform automates call center duties, guides self-enrollment flows, validates client information, and performs creditor settlement calculations. Retape integrates with existing legacy CRMs to synchronize contact history, payment schedules, and account notes while reducing manual data entry. Its software targets mid-market collection and debt settlement teams that want to streamline processes, improve workflow consistency, and maintain compliance across communication channels.

productsAndServices.description: Resolve CRM is an AI-native CRM platform for debt-settlement companies that automates intake, client workflows, and creditor settlement tasks.
